# Compare two Excel files side-by-side with NVIDIA ChatRTX

**Hook:**
You have two Excel files and need to find what changed between them. Instead of scrolling through rows for hours, you can upload both files into NVIDIA ChatRTX and ask it to compare them. In a minute or two, you’ll get a clear list of differences you can trust. This guide shows you how to do it step-by-step.

## Before you start
- A **computer** (Windows or Mac) with at least 8 GB of RAM.
- Two **Excel files** (.xlsx) you want to compare. They should have matching columns (e.g., both have “Product”, “Sales”, “Region”).
- A **free NVIDIA account** (sign-up at [chatrtx.nvidia.com](https://chatrtx.nvidia.com)).
- Roughly **10 minutes** total time.

---

## Step 1 — Sign in to NVIDIA ChatRTX
Open your web browser and go to [chatrtx.nvidia.com](https://chatrtx.nvidia.com). You’ll see a login button in the top-right corner. Click it. A login box appears with options like “Sign in with Google” or “Sign in with Microsoft”. Choose the one you prefer. After you sign in, the ChatRTX dashboard opens. You’ll see a chat box in the centre and a few example prompts below it. You’ll know it worked when you see your name or email in the top-right corner and the chat box is ready for typing.

💬 Example:
(No typing needed here — just click the login button.)

---

## Step 2 — Upload your first Excel file
In the chat box, type “Upload a file” and press Enter. A file picker window opens. Navigate to your first Excel file on your computer, select it, and click Open. The file uploads and ChatRTX confirms it’s ready. You’ll see a small file icon and the file name appear in the chat. You’ll know it worked when the file name appears in the chat and you see a green checkmark next to it.

💬 Example:
(You type nothing — just pick the file from your computer.)

---

## Step 3 — Upload your second Excel file
Repeat Step 2 to upload your second Excel file. ChatRTX now has both files in the chat. You’ll see both file names listed, one after the other. You’ll know it worked when both file names appear in the chat with green checkmarks.

💬 Example:
(You type nothing — just pick the second file from your computer.)

---

## Step 4 — Ask ChatRTX to compare the files
In the chat box, type:
“Compare these two Excel files and list the differences in a table.”

Then press Enter. ChatRTX starts processing. It reads both files, compares the data row by row, and prepares a summary. You’ll see a spinning icon or a “Processing…” message while it works. After a few seconds, a table appears showing rows that differ, with columns like “Row”, “Column”, “Value in File 1”, and “Value in File 2”. You’ll know it worked when you see a clear table of differences in the chat.

💬 Example:
Compare these two Excel files and list the differences in a table.

---

## Step 5 — Review the differences table
Scan the table ChatRTX produced. Each row shows a cell that changed between the two files. Look for the “Value in File 1” and “Value in File 2” columns to see what actually changed. If the table is too long, ask ChatRTX to “Show only rows where Sales changed by more than 10%.” You’ll know it worked when the table is shorter and focuses on the biggest differences.

💬 Example:
Show only rows where Sales changed by more than 10%.

---

## Step 6 — Ask for a summary or export
If you want a quick summary, type:
“Summarise the key differences in three bullet points.”

ChatRTX writes a short summary you can copy into an email or note. If you want to save the table, ask:
“Export the differences table as a CSV file.”

ChatRTX creates a download link. Click it to save the file to your computer. You’ll know it worked when you see a download link or a summary that makes sense.

## Common mistakes
- **Uploading files with different column names**: ChatRTX compares column by column. If the columns don’t match (e.g., one file has “Revenue” and the other has “Income”), the comparison will miss data or give errors. Fix: Rename columns in both files so they match exactly before uploading.
- **Ignoring the processing time**: If your files are large (over 10,000 rows), ChatRTX may take longer than a few seconds. Fix: Wait patiently; don’t close the browser or refresh the page until you see the results.
- **Assuming every difference is important**: ChatRTX lists every change, even tiny ones like a space in a product name. Fix: Use the “Show only rows where…” prompt to filter for meaningful differences.

---

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life:** You manage budgets or track inventory across months. Instead of opening two Excel files and squinting at rows, you upload them to ChatRTX and get a clean list of changes in seconds. You save time and avoid mistakes.
- **For your business or work:** Your team shares monthly sales reports in Excel. When a manager asks “What changed from last month?”, you can run this comparison in minutes and send a clear summary. No more guessing or manual scanning.
- **If you're just getting started:** Start with two small Excel files (under 5,000 rows). Once you see how easy it is, you’ll trust ChatRTX for bigger files and more complex comparisons.

---

## Try it now
Open [chatrtx.nvidia.com](https://chatrtx.nvidia.com), sign in, and upload two small Excel files you already have. Ask ChatRTX to compare them and list the differences. You’ll have your answer in under two minutes.
